propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate developed and maintained the alert queue and case views, including server-side paging and column virtualisation.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the views and the paging work directly.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate owned the Jest and Cypress test suites and added a queue-load smoke test that gates releases.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the smoke test document the test ownership.

propositions.canonicalProposition: Median alert-queue load time fell from 6.2 seconds to 1.4 seconds after the paging release, measured by real-user monitoring over four weeks against the published baseline.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the times, period, baseline and measurement source; the work sample and reference confirm them.

expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for each application release are only partly documented in the release notes.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the load-time result as stated for the alert queue and the four-week window; do not extend it to other views.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask how hand-over conditions were recorded for each application release.
